task_title: PERF-016: GET /users must never swap a namespace's git identities for memory authors when the git scan fails
task_criteria: src/http/routes/users.ts documents the served author set: git identities from namespaces whose scan SUCCEEDS, UNION memory-record authors only from namespaces whose git repo is VERIFIED empty or absent, and NOTHING from a namespace whose scan fails operationally (timeout, non-zero exit, I/O error). Grep-provable in the file header.

src/http/routes/authorAggregation-no-swap-perf016.test.ts pins the no-swap rule for a namespace carrying BOTH git authors and memory-record authors: an injected lookup that rejects (timeout / operational error) yields no memory author and never calls the memory lookup, while a resolved empty array still falls back. Command: npx vitest run src/http/routes/authorAggregation-no-swap-perf016.test.ts src/http/routes/authorAggregation-fallback-semantics.test.ts src/http/routes/users-perf014.test.ts must pass.

.coding-hermes/board/evidence-PERF-016-20261117.txt records the live acceptance measurement on the daemon store /home/kara/.duckbrain-live/namespaces (288 namespace dirs): three consecutive GET /users returning an IDENTICAL identity set, with per-request latency, peak concurrent 'git log --all' count, and the stated loadavg. The artifact is committed and states identity sets identical across all three: YES.
npx tsc -p tsconfig.build.json passes on the tree and test-counts.json matches the live suite (a new suite was added).

Both reach the status-gated logic at authorAggregation.ts:80-125, where gitFailed forces the db scan to empty and logs result=no-fallback-on-failure.

items.criterion: A real git timeout (execFile killed) is classified as 'timeout' and therefore does NOT fall back to memory authors — the actual production failure mode, not only the injected-lookup seam.

items.criterion: The change does not regress the rest of the suite: full `npx vitest run` is green.
